description: Build a weekly Garmin scorecard with movement, sleep, HRV, stress, Body Battery, bottlenecks and actions. Read-only and non-medical.

compare_days.description: Prior comparison window in days. Use 0 to disable comparison.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the Garmin calendar date queried from Connect, e.g. America/New_York. Invalid names fall back to UTC. Omit or pass UTC to keep the previous UTC-day behavior.

name: garmin_weekly_summary
title: Garmin Weekly Health Review
